published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: Enhancement with Restoration points for Water Shield. Without Improved Fire Nova, it uses Magma Totem. Lightning Shield still beats Water Shield, however often the shaman is hit.
rotation: Pre-pull: Strength of Earth IV at -5.5s, Windfury Totem at -4.5s, Mana Spring at -3.5s, Lightning Shield at -2.5s, Magma Totem at -1s
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down, with at least 20s left
Magma Totem when it is down, with at least 2s left
Rage of the Farseer with the on-use trinket, Blood Fury with them, then the other cooldowns
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Earth Shock while Flame Shock has more than 1s left
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Lightning Shield when it is down and nothing else is ready. Its orbs fire at the boss when the shaman takes a hit, about 2 a minute.
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Water Shield goes unused, because Lightning Shield does more.
Assumed: Maelstrom Weapon procs 2 times a minute per point. It can't be tested until the beta reaches level 34.
Open: whether Stormstrike can trigger Elemental Focus. If it can, Enhancement gets more Clearcasting procs than shown.
Assumed: the shaman takes 2 damage hits a minute. Each one fires Lightning Shield.
Fire Nova uses client build 70425's values: 0.143 coefficient, rank 5 base damage 232 to 259.
Assumed: another shaman's Flametongue Totem stacks with this shaman's Windfury Weapon. It adds 18 to 19 DPS at 180s and isn't tested in game yet.
The relic is Totem of the Storm, within 0.4 DPS of Burning Totem here. It lets Lightning Bolt trigger Maelstrom Weapon at half the chance.
notes: mksettings -spec enh -apl magma -talents 051003-054030021005112151-053020001 -race Orc -gear level60_phase1_synthetic -duration 180 -level 60 (standards 25: the raid's Grace of Air and Flametongue Totem; the shaman drops Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem, Mana Spring Totem and Magma Totem itself).
